newsitem.title: USA: Prince George's Cty, Md., adopts $1.2 bln budget.
newsitem.headline: Prince George's Cty, Md., adopts $1.2 bln budget.

text.p: The Prince George's County, Md., council on Thursday unanimously approved a $1.2 billion budget for fiscal 1998, a 3.5 percent increase over this year's spending plan.
The Board of Education received a record $780.3 million appropriation, the council said. The $44 million increase in public school spending is six percent more than last year's level.
The budget also diverts about $24 million in park funds to new school construction, and the Police Department received a 1.2 percent budget increase.

"This council has demonstrated exceptional vision as we continue to make decisions promoting economic development and significant policy shifts that will improve future revenue projections," Council Chair Dorothy Bailey, D-District 7, said.

In another budget move, Prince George's County and Montgomery County joined in approving a $447.7 million budget for the Washington Suburban Sanitary Commisiosn, including a 2.9 percent rate increase.
